This v2 answers that: 26024 bytes and 52 top-level keys against v1's 26. Every key I named as absent is now present - whatThisCloses, failsIf, namedCorpusNotAuthored, namedExecutesLimbNote, proposedLaterWork, discipline, namingStandingCarried, liveAssuranceStageVerbatim, liveStatusVerbatim, condition2StandingCarried and condition5StandingCarried - alongside parentReview, recordedInputs, remeasurementClause, liveRowVerbatim, rowLocationDiscipline and eligibilityEffect.
